page.overview:
Who is Gordon?

Ensign Gordon was a Human Starfleet engineer in the 24th century.

In 2374 he participated in a secret mission on a captured Jem'Hadar attack ship to destroy a ketracel-white depot in Cardassian space. The ship suffered damage and subsequently crashed on a planet where the crew of another Jem'Hadar ship was also stranded.

After Keevan, the Vorta, provided the Starfleet crew with information on the Jem'Hadar's attack plan to save himself, Gordon voiced reservation at what would effectively be the slaughter of the Jem'Hadar. Nevertheless, the attack went as planned and the Jem'Hadar were all killed, while Gordon was the sole Starfleet casualty in the attack. ()

According to the script, his first name was Paul. The first name of Paul is also given in the .
